faq_items.question: Is the Good Vibes Only printable really free to download?
faq_items.answer: Yes. It is a completely free printable PDF with no email sign-up required. Download it, print as many copies as you like at home, and frame them for any room. It is licensed for personal home use, so print freely for yourself and for gifts.

faq_items.question: What size does the Good Vibes Only printable print at?
faq_items.answer: The design fits standard photo sizes like 5x7, 8x10, and 11x14, so any off-the-shelf frame works with no custom matting. Print at 8x10 for a versatile desk or shelf piece, or scale up to 11x14 or A4 for a larger statement above a bed or sofa.

faq_items.question: What paper should I use to print it at home?
faq_items.answer: Use matte photo paper or 65-to-100 lb cardstock instead of plain copy paper. Heavier stock gives the print a substantial, gallery feel and will not curl inside a frame. Set your printer to High or Best quality and print at 100 percent, or Actual size, for the crispest result.

faq_items.question: Is a Good Vibes Only sign good for a dorm room?
faq_items.answer: It is close to perfect for dorms. There is no shipping to wait on, nothing expensive to lose at move-out, and adhesive mounting strips let you hang a lightweight frame with zero wall damage. Print a spare copy to lean on a shelf or clip to a board too.

faq_items.question: How do I keep Good Vibes Only from looking cheesy?
faq_items.answer: Choose a version with clean typography and generous white space, then frame it simply and place it intentionally. Group it with a couple of calmer prints, like a line-art botanical or minimalist shape, so it reads as the friendly note in a collected set rather than a novelty poster.
